title: eclipta prostrata
intro: Eclipta prostrata, commonly known as False Daisy or Bhringaraj, is a flowering plant native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Asia. It is a popular herb in Ayurvedic and traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and supporting hair growth. The therapeutic actions of Eclipta prostrata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Eclipta prostrata include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
